asset.name: The Great Wave
asset.credit: The Howard Mansfield Collection, Purchase, Rogers Fund, 1936

arguments.brief: A one-work exhibition for an art viewer inspecting the two inscriptions in Hokusai's Great Wave. Open with complete print and a single control, then show a readable close-up, two brief explanations and a small location overview. Deep ink blue outside the print; accessible and responsive; quiet museum editorial treatment.

One-work exhibition for a visitor inspecting two inscriptions in Hokusai's Great Wave. Deep ink blue background, artwork first, switch to close-up with two concise explanations and a locator, usable on phone and laptop.

notes.text: The rectangle names the series Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji and the print Under the Wave off Kanagawa.
